basic_info.description: Tastefully renovated and perfectly located in the heart of Alamo Sq., 650 Steiner #3 is a stylish and comfortable retreat with some of SF's most iconic green spaces, culinary hotspots, and everyday conveniences at your fingertips. This chic 2BD/1BA condo is set in a well-managed 8-unit building at the foot of Alamo Sq. Park, just moments from the Painted Ladies and blocks to Hayes and NOPA's Divis corridor. The home features a highly efficient floor plan with zero wasted space, generous closets, and stylish upgrades including a beautifully remodeled kitchen, refinished wood floors & modern light fixtures. The open-concept living space flows seamlessly into the dining and kitchen spacesperfect for daily living and entertaining. Set at the rear of the building, the unit has easy access to the oversized, sunny shared deck. Completing the home is a secure building intercom system, keyless unit entry, on-site laundry facilities, independent 1 car garage parking with interior access, and dedicated storage. Walk Score 97 with easy access to MUNI, tech shuttles, and freeways - a timeless SF location that will never go out of style!
